arithmetic: Original FP32 subtraction, ordered double accumulation, Euclidean float output; no reassociation

modes.G0: Original 512 threads, one leaf per CTA
modes.G1: 32 threads, one leaf per CTA; all other THREAD_NUM uses unchanged
modes.G2: 32 threads, three leaves per CTA, ten lanes per leaf, lane-stride10 over all20 original slots; lanes30/31 inactive

work_invariants: visited leaf node IDs and original task order
diagnostic_scope: fixed32, two reverse-order fresh processes/mode under NSYS; profiler leaf inclusive durations are mechanism evidence only
ncu_scope: One matching first diagnostic leaf launch per mode, fixed32 sequence, skip first2 warmup leaf launches; diagnostic counters, not formal latency
gate_E: All correctness/resource/sanitizer/work gates; G2 leaf-inclusive sum < G1 in BOTH NSYS order rounds, matching structural counts, and at least one direct physical counter consistent with mapping (CTA/warps/instructions). Otherwise STOP without256-query formal runs. G1 leaf benefit judged independently on both rounds. No extra candidates or favorable replacements.
formal_scope: One complete256-query Host-ready pass per fresh process; query transfer/allocation/traversal/materialization/sort/full ID-distance return/free/sync included; static data/index load,warmup,oracle,profiler,filewrites excluded

statistics.primary: Geometric mean of six round-paired time ratios, separately G0/G1,G1/G2,G0/G2
statistics.win_gate: CI lower>1 AND at least5/6 process wins; otherwise inconclusive unless CI upper<1
report: all6 order strata plus pair-relative-order splits
statistics.interpretation: Fixed reused confirmation-set run variation, not fresh-query or distribution generalization

gpu: User-authorized physicalGPU1/NUMA0, same UUID as diagnosis, live idle and shared lock before every process; no foreign signals or GPU settings changes
fault_rule: Stop on first mismatch, invalid runtime, foreign activity, unsupported admission or input drift; retain all failures. No automatic replacement. Missing NCU counters individually unsupported, not invented.
qualification: D96/960 N4097 existing tie/self/equal-vector fixtures K1/8/32 and last nonempty leaf; G1/G2 memcheck/racecheck/synccheck; isolated real leaf-kernel all-slot fixture forces1/2/3-leaf tails, size1..20 and self/equal-ID-distinct cases; separate count binaries only for work receipts
novelty: Engineering attribution of conventional task packing, not a new research thesis. Generic packing novelty killed by prior tree/SIMT work; this bounded experiment does not rescue it.
profiling_admission: Before runtime tests, ncu --query-metrics on physicalGPU1 returned ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM. No privilege escalation or driver change. NCU hardware counters unavailable; retain probe. E5 uses NSYS-recorded runtime CTA/grid counts and same-work lower leaf duration, not a scheduling-overhead hardware counter. No unsupported quantity is imputed.
